headline: Sunday Heat Continues: Mid-90s with Light Lake Breezes
lede: Sunday, September 6th brings another warm day to the Ozarks with highs near 101°F and a low chance of precipitation. Lake levels remain boater-friendly after recent rains. Beat the afternoon heat with early morning lake time, air-conditioned shows, or shaded dining. Perfect weather for a relaxed family day before the workweek returns.

featured.title: Evening on Table Rock Lake
featured.where: Table Rock Lake / State Park Marina area
featured.why: Calmer waters and beautiful sunsets make this a favorite for first-timers. Rent a pontoon early or enjoy shoreline views from the parks. Confirm marina availability locally.

plan.title: Early Lake or Breakfast
plan.detail: Coolest part of the day. Head to Table Rock for sunrise fishing or a relaxed breakfast at Steamy Joe Cafe with Ozark views before the heat builds.

plan.title: Indoor Shows & AC Relief
plan.detail: Escape the peak heat (heat index near 105°F) with a matinee at King's Castle Theatre or Legends in Concert. Silver Dollar City offers shaded walks and indoor attractions.

plan.title: Evening Entertainment
plan.detail: Catch an evening show like Amazing Acrobats of Shanghai or a lakeside dinner. Temperatures drop comfortably after sunset for outdoor seating.

indoor.detail: Dublin's Irish Tenors & The Celtic Ladies — lively matinee perfect for families seeking AC and culture.

indoor.detail: Afternoon tribute show with live band in a comfortable theater. Great for all ages and a cool break from the sun.
